Vijay Sharma vs Food Corporation Of India on 18 July, 2024 
Author: Sanjeev Narula
Bench: Sanjeev Narula
 $~87
 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
 + W.P.(C) 9748/2024
 Vijay Sharma 
 Th
 
 
 ve
 Food Corporation Of India 
 Through: Mr. Manoj, Standing
 Food Corporation o
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Narula
 Or
% 18.07.2024 Cm Appl. 39967/2024 (Exemption)
1. Exemption is granted, subject to all just exceptions. 
2. The Applicant shall file legible and clearer copies of exempted documents, compliant with
practice rules, before the next date of hearing. 
3. Accordingly, the application stands disposed of. W.P.(C) 9748/2024 & Cm Appl. 39966/2024
(Interim Relief)
4.  The dispute in the present writ petition arises from the Agreement dated 25th July, 2018, entered into by the parties for the work of "Demolition and Reconstruction of 20 nos. of Residential Flats in Sector-27, Noida". On account of disputes between the parties under the said agreement, the Respondent has, through an undated communication [Annexure P-1], directed as follows:
This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/07/2024 at 01:51:28 "The above said work was awarded to you vide above referred letter dated Vijay Sharma vs Food Corporation Of India on 18 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120825196/
1 05.07.2018 and was completed by you on dated 25.02.2021. Whereas, during the maintenance period, various defects were noticed in the above said work and accordingly you were given various notices on dated 08.09.2021, 24.11.2021, 23.12.2021, 12.01.2022, 13.01.2022, 27.01.2022,
26.05.2022, 06.09.2022 to attend the repairs of the defects noticed during maintenance/guarantee period, but you failed to attend the repairs required, as per specifications.
Keeping in view of the bad conditions of the building as well as safety of the resident, this office has to go for Testing of FCI Flats (F- 25A&B to F-34A&B) located at Sector 27 Noida, their structural stability and strength of the building. It is needless to mention here that the said testing was carried out in your presence at FCI Flats sector 27, Noida. The results of Testing Report so submitted by the appointed agency indicates that the work was not executed according to specifications and also strength of the structure was not as per requirement of scheduled items resulting various losses to the Corporation.
And whereas, as per "Performa of Guarantee to be executed by the contractor for removal of defects after completion" of MTF, "Guarantor agreed to give a guarantee to the effect that the said structures will remain structurally stable, safe & sound for five years from the date of completion of work. The Guarantor hereby guarantees that work undertaken by him will render the repaired structures completely safe and the minimum life of such work executed by the GUARANTOR treatment shall be five years to be reckoned from the date after the maintenance period, prescribed in the contract". 
That if GUARANTOR fails to execute the defected work or commits breach there under then the GUARANTOR will indemnify the Principal and his successors against all loss, damage, cost, expense or otherwise which may be incurred by him by reason of any default on the part of the GUARANTOR in performance and observance of this supplementary agreement. As to the amount of loss and/or damage and/or cost incurred by the Government the decision of the Engineer-in-charge will be final and binding on the parties. 
Also, under Special Conditions of MTF at S.No.9, "the Contractor has to undertake construction of works for certification as per GRIHA norms and accordingly register the project for the maximum star rating with in the ambient of scope of work". For submission of GRIHA certificate, this office had issued various notices vide letters dated 13.01.2022, 26.04.2022, 03.08.2022, 06.09.2022, but GRIHA certificate has not been submitted by you till date for which amount of Rs. 1,50,000/-
This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/07/2024 at 01:51:28 was withheld by this office. 
Therefore, I Naresh Kumar Mehta, Assistant General Manager(Civil), FCI, Headquarters, New Delhi in exercise of the powers conferred on me by the aforesaid agreement under clauses 2(b)
17,22,29(1),29(2),34(ii) for and on behalf of FCI hereby:
Vijay Sharma vs Food Corporation Of India on 18 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120825196/
2 1. Forfeit the Security Deposit and Withheld Amount as per details below:-
Forfeiture of Security Deposit lying with FCI against above said work Rs. 26,05,845/-
Forfeiture of Withheld Amount lying with FCI (Non submission of GRIHA Certificate) Rs. 1,50,000/-
Total Rs.27,55,845/-
2. Debar your firm from participating in any future tenders of the corporation for a period of FIVE years from the date of issue of this letter.
3. You shall not be allowed to participate in the tendering process for the work related with the repairs/strengthening/renovation of the said Flats at Sector-27, Noida. 
This is without prejudice to FCI right to take action under any clauses or sub clauses of the agreement and to realize FCI dues and losses and damages whatsoever under clauses or sub-clauses. 
Moreover, any losses and damages out of and incurred by Corporation by such conduct, will be recovered from you without prejudice to any other rights and remedies of the Corporation under the contract and law."
[Emphasis supplied]
5. Mr. Ankur Mahindro, Counsel for Petitioner assails the aforenoted communication, to the extent that it directs debarment of the Petitioner from participating in any future tenders of the Respondent, for a period of 5 years from the date of issuance of the said letter. 
6. It is pointed out that there was no show cause notice issued to the Petitioner prior to passing of the said decision and in fact, the decision is not even dated. Further, the Petitioner was not afforded any opportunity to put forth their stand, to respond to the allegations on which the impugned action This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/07/2024 at 01:51:29 is premised. 
7. In light of the above, on a prima facie consideration of the submissions and the documents placed on record by the Petitioner, the Court observes that the impugned undated communication issued by the Respondent, to the extent that it debars the Petitioner from participating in any future bids of the Respondent for 5 years, was issued without issuing a show cause notice or affording an opportunity to the Petitioner to put forth their stand and is thus in violation of the principles of natural justice. 
Vijay Sharma vs Food Corporation Of India on 18 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120825196/
3 8. Accordingly, till the next date of hearing, the directions for debarring the Petitioner from participating in any future tenders as directed in the impugned communication shall remain stayed. 
9. Mr. Manoj, standing counsel appearing on advance notice, accepts notice on behalf of Respondent. Let the reply be filed within a period of four weeks from today. Rejoinder, if any, be filed within a period of two weeks thereafter. 
10. Re-notify on 23rd October, 2024.
SANJEEV NARULA, J JULY 18, 2024/ab This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/07/2024 at 01:51:30 Vijay Sharma vs Food Corporation Of India on 18 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120825196/
